message: Your thinking is sound, having the final serve as a meta-cognitive exercise and introduction to the portfolio. However, I suspect you task is like that of a migrating salmon readying for the spawn: swimming upstream after having survived all those dams and barges on the way down, life in the ocean for several years, and your final days going against the grain for god knows how many miles. We've had a portfolio culture for about 15 years and I can't imagine going to a final exam culture like you have. You gotta be ready for the long haul on changing that one!
